text:
Jordan: Quick heads-up — Helios Bank wants a short POC next Tue. Main asks: SAML SSO (signed assertions + cert rotation), SCIM for ~10k users with group sync, RBAC mapped to AD groups, and wildcard domain validation for *.helios.com. Also need a smoke-test env and a ballpark for reserved capacity pricing. Who's available to scope?

Priya: I can lead the technical POC. Need to confirm whether they want Okta or Azure AD as IdP (will change SAML config a bit).

Jordan: They're mostly Okta but may have a secondary Azure AD for contractors. Okta is the primary.

Mateo: Security check — we'll need to confirm assertion encryption vs signing only. Helios wants signed + encrypted assertions for finance data. Also require SAML metadata exchange over mTLS.

Anya: From product: we can run SAML with signed+encrypted assertions in Private & Dedicated. Hosted has signing only by default, but we can enable encryption for Dedicated or Private.

Chris: For SCIM at 10k users: we'll recommend pagination + bulk diff to avoid spikes. We'll need to throttle to 200 reqs/min per tenant in POC. Also we should pre-warm the KV cache for frequent group lookups.

Sam: Pricing ask — they want a committed quote for Dedicated for POC month then convert to reserved capacity if they like perf. Quick numbers: POC (2xA100 equiv) estimate $12k/mo pro-rated, Reserved (3 mo commit) discounts apply. Need finance sign-off.

Jordan: OK. Action items: (1) Priya scope test plan, (2) Mateo to confirm SAML encryption feasibility on Hosted vs Dedicated, (3) Chris to draft SCIM throttling and mapping example, (4) Sam to draft provisional pricing.

Priya: Draft test plan sketch:
```
- Identity: configure Okta SAML IdP, exchange metadata
- User sync: SCIM full sync + incremental group updates (10k users)
- RBAC: map Okta groups -> app roles, verify permission enforcement
- Domain proofing: validate *.helios.com via DNS TXT or ACME
- Failover: simulate IdP outage and confirm fallback policy (local auth for admins)
```
I'll run the first two tests in staging.

Chris: SCIM mapping example (quick):
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [
    {"op": "replace", "path": "groups", "value": [{"value":"finance","display":"Finance"}]}
  ]
}
```
Throttling: 200rpm, page size 200, bulk export for initial seed.

Mateo: Legal/security redlines to expect: enforceable data processing addendum, SOC2 + PCI scoping question, key rotation cadence, and access logs retention. I'll start the questionnaire.

legal-bot: Security questionnaire requested: https://redwood-internal/sg/questionnaire/helios-175888 — please fill the SOC2 attestation and encryption Qs.

Sam: I'll draft the provisional pricing and include a Dedicated POC line item + short conversion discount. Expect a draft by EOD tomorrow.

Anya: Note: For domain controls we support two options: (1) DNS TXT record validation, (2) ACME-based cert prove. For wildcard *.helios.com we'll do DNS TXT to avoid cert churn during POC.

Jordan: Timeline check — POC kickoff target: Tue 09:00 PT. Priya, can you confirm staging slots and any infra needs by EOD today?

Priya: Confirmed. Need Chris to provision a dedicated staging pool (2x A100 equiv) and enable SCIM endpoints + SAML encryption toggle.

Chris: Will provision. tagging the deploy request: `deploy-bot` — please queue a private staging pool for tenant helios-poc.

deploy-bot: Request received. Provisioning window scheduled for 1758884800 (provision ETA ~1h).

Mateo: One more security blocker: they require customer-managed keys (BYOK) for production. Not required for POC but flag for enterprise contract.

Jordan: Perfect — this gives us a clear runway. I'll update Helios with this plan and get Okta metadata. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
